name: A-MEM
ontology_notes: Zettelkasten notes. Paper eq.1 m_i = {c_i, t_i, K_i, G_i, X_i, e_i, L_i} (content, timestamp, keywords, tags, contextual description, embedding, links). Code MemoryNote in WujiangXu/A-mem memory_layer.py and WujiangXu/A-mem-sys agentic_memory/memory_system.py. Production repo is A-mem-sys (394 stars, MIT). No character autobiography, relationship state, lore, or OOC types. One note bag per agent.

ontology.evidence: Paper §3.1 MemoryNote fields content, keywords, tags, context, links, timestamp. Code class MemoryNote. Tags and category are LLM slogans, not typed companion tables.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Every new interaction becomes a note via LLM prompt P_s1 (paper eq.2). AgenticMemorySystem.add_note in memory_layer.py and A-mem-sys memory_system.py. Link generation and memory evolution then rewrite neighbors. No refusal of jokes or jailbreaks.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Query embedding cosine top-k (paper §3.4, k=10 in §4.2). HybridRetriever.retrieve / SimpleEmbeddingRetriever.search in memory_layer.py. A-mem-sys AgenticMemorySystem.search and search_agentic. Linked notes in the same box are also pulled. No retrieve-nothing gate.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Memory evolution (paper eq.7) can update neighbor context, keywords, and tags. A-mem-sys AgenticMemorySystem.update and process_memory. No delete-on-contradiction. Two opposing notes can both remain.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Each note stores timestamp and last_accessed (YYYYMMDDHHMM). LoCoMo eval has a temporal-reasoning slice (paper §4.1). No last-Tuesday query language in retrieve.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: One memories dict keyed by note id. LoCoMo speakers are two peers in the eval set, not store types. No user vs character vs relationship tables.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Top-k similar notes are always eligible. Paper Figure 3 and §3.4 have no skip-relevant-hit policy.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Stored content is concatenated into the retriever string and later injected into the agent prompt. No provenance or trust tags. Evolution can rewrite neighbor context from a new note.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: A-mem-sys AgenticMemorySystem.delete(memory_id) exists. Paper §3 describes link and evolve, not a user forget-that. Benchmark repo memory_layer.py has no first-class forget command.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Write pays LLM calls for note construction, link generation (P_s2), and neighbor evolution (P_s3), plus one embedding. Read is one query embed plus top-k. Paper §4.3 claims about 1200 tokens per memory operation versus 16900 for LoCoMo/MemGPT full-context baselines.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT LICENSE on A-mem and A-mem-sys. OllamaController and local MiniLM in memory_layer.py. GPT path needs OpenAI. Intimate chat can stay local if you run the local LLM backend.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Neither A-mem nor A-mem-sys ships an MCP server.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Agent RAG with evolving Zettelkasten notes. Retrieve-then-generate on LoCoMo. No user vs character vs relationship types. No silence. Poisoned chat can evolve into neighbor context. LoCoMo wins do not score companion identity, silence, or poisoning.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo QA (7,512 items across multi-hop, temporal, open-domain, single-hop, adversarial) plus DialSim
published_eval.claimed_score: GPT-4o-mini A-Mem average rank 1.2, temporal F1 45.85 vs LoCoMo 18.41 and MemGPT 25.52, multi-hop F1 27.02 (Table 1). DialSim F1 3.45 vs LoCoMo 2.55 and MemGPT 1.18 (Table 2).
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Fact QA on long two-speaker friend chats (LoCoMo) and TV-show multi-party quizzes (DialSim). F1/BLEU against gold answers. LoCoMo does not score companion identity, silence, or persona poisoning.

open_unknowns: Whether add_note or process_memory ever refuses to store a jailbreak as keywords or context.
Whether linked-box expansion can be turned off, or whether a high-score trauma note always pulls its neighbors.
Exact k used per LoCoMo category versus the code default 10 (paper points to Appendix A.5).
